summary: This bill amends the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to gradually eliminate the separate minimum wage for tipped employees, ensuring they receive the full federal minimum wage, and establishes new rules for tip retention and pooling, including requiring employee votes for tip pool establishment and prohibiting employers from keeping any portion of tips.

scores.thoughts: This bill significantly amends the Fair Labor Standards Act to eliminate the sub-minimum wage for tipped employees, requiring them to be paid the full minimum wage. It also establishes new rules for tip retention and pooling, giving employees more control over tip distribution and preventing employers from keeping tips or using them for transaction fees. These changes are designed to strengthen worker protections and increase their earnings, aligning with the 'more labor laws and union rights' end of the spectrum.
